craftingQuests.challenge_description: Welcome to Signature Quest ⅩI where you can craft an exclusive and unique Signature Highlight from your favorite players and teams using your collection! Collectors who submit edition #1 as part of the Highlight Submission requirement and complete the quest will be awarded with edition #1 of the Signature Highlight (provided it has not already been crafted by another collector during a previous Signature Quest). All other editions will be randomized amongst eligible collectors. You may only craft one Signature Edition per Signature Quest. Get started below now, choose wisely!
craftingQuests.reward_description: New Signature edition of the highlight selected for your quest!
craftingQuests.humanized_rules:
• Submit to freeze the required highlights by 11:59:59 pm PT on June 8, 2026 to receive a free airdrop of a Signature Highlight edition on or about July 24, 2026.
  • When you “freeze” a highlight, you will not be able to transact with that frozen highlight outside of this quest until after the unfreeze date of September 8, 2026 at 11:59:59 pm PT. Any frozen highlights used to complete the “Team Freeze” requirement of the quest will remain frozen until the unfreeze date, whether you complete the quest or not.
  • If the quest is not completed by you, your highlights will be automatically unfrozen on the unfreeze date, at which time you will again be able to transact with those highlights.
  • If the quest is completed by you, your highlight editions used to complete the “Highlight Submission” quest requirement will be surrendered forever and permanently removed from your collection. Permanently surrendered highlights will subsequently be taken out of circulation.
  • The edition numbers for each Signature Highlight will be randomly distributed to those who complete the quest provided, however, that collectors who submit an edition #1 and complete the quest are automatically awarded the corresponding edition #1 Signature Highlight provided it has not already been crafted by another collector during a previous Signature Quest. The total number of minted highlights (i.e., edition size) will match the total number of questers who earn the specific Signature Highlight.
  • Limit of one play and one Signature Highlight for each authorized user.
  • Highlights are provided “as is” and, at all times, subject to these rules, the Terms. It is prohibited here and on the NHL Breakaway Platform to hold or control multiple accounts, to loan highlights to complete quests, or to otherwise act in a manner designed to evade rules or terms. Reward edition numbering remains subject to adjustment until final delivery. Published dates and times are best estimates subject to change.
